real_use_case: Preserve a bounded single-sample gVCF as a compressed, indexed artifact after reference and retention checks.
upstream_status: GA4GH BGZF SAMv1.6 revision b5341fbb5181cc7811c10c741a682149ab0cccf8, VCF 4.2 printing c101c79, declared GATK HaplotypeCaller 4.6.2.0 and qualified bcftools 1.24 / HTSlib 1.24; source pins checked 2026-11-25.
license: Independent implementation of public format requirements and independently constructed synthetic records. Existing qualified bcftools MIT/Expat build reused without redistribution; GSL, Perl and plugins disabled. No third-party implementation, prose or fixture bytes included.
supported_profile: resources/gvcf-artifact-profiles/gatk-haplotypecaller-4.6.2.0-vcf42-grch38-bgzf-v1.json: one diploid gVCF sample, primary GRCh38.p14 autosomes, reference blocks and bounded single concrete variants.
resource_budget: At most 1 MiB source, 32 records, 256 header lines and 64 KiB per line; one read-only pinned 3339739109-byte FASTA scan, 32 KiB BGZF chunks, 2 MiB compressed output, 1 MiB CSI, bounded child output and a 600-second total timeout; one thread, no network.
output_contract: Tool-neutral CapabilityResult from omnigenis.capabilities.gvcf_artifact.GvcfArtifactResult.to_dict, containing seven conformance predicates, immutable retention/query evidence and derived artifact manifests. Binary artifacts returned together only after complete success.
known_issues: Qualification is limited to the declared synthetic subset; no actual GATK caller execution or full gVCF compatibility claim. This operation preserves artifacts; it does not normalize alleles, transform likelihoods, perform joint genotyping, infer calls, establish callability or support scientific negative findings. Reference-block concordance checks the REF anchor and bounds; it does not prove every base through END is callable. Unsupported INFO content, alternate callers, multiple samples, non-autosomal domains, additional concrete ALTs and general indels are rejected. No default pipeline activation, interpretation, reporting, clinical use or release authorization.
security: Strict preflight, actual reference/executor byte identity, bounded subprocess capture/deadline, isolated temporary output and cleanup, no partial artifact bundle or private path export.
disable_path: Explicit module invocation only. Do not select this execution profile; no automatic fallback.
